'''obi-wan-wonder Hoth Heaven ( new and Improved)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[obi-wan-wonder]]
* '''Published:''' 25 August 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay)]]
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 Cloud City East Platform (Docking B HothHeav.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I changed  this deck alot, from my old deck, by putting in new planets, taking out unuseful sites and sprucing it up. It is a well balanced deck that can get cards out faster and and has many small ships like x-wings that when in numbers can make  differece.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

I followed most of Cam's advice and hopefully this deck is better. I put in extra planets so i can force drain more and generate force more, of course. I took out about half my hoth sites beause i never use the interior sites and they don't generate much force. I put in alot of starships so I can force drain in space more. many of my characters are pilots and i put most of them in starships to add to the power  i will hopefully win more battles.

I took out some scouts because they aren't pilots and have low power, so now my ground forces have low numbers but alot of power. My ground forces can force drain alot with EBO (+2) at evey location so that is good. I took out some effects because i didn't really need them.

When i get most of my sites and planets out i will be able to hopefully win in 6 turns or less because of high force draining.

be sure to check out my new and improved death star dynasty deck
